title: Fix manufacturing enum fallback in item journals
summary: Item journal code no longer treats ordinary lines and templates as manufacturing records when Manufacturing subscribers are absent. New Boolean predicate events that default to false replace the enum getters at the standard call sites, and the change is applied to all country layers.
key_points: Adds false-default Boolean predicate events, with Manufacturing subscribers, to classify production and consumption records
Used for salesperson dimensions, journal line setup, item tracking validation, recurring journal selection and the Inventory Posting - Test report
Existing enum getter procedures and events remain available
Extensions that customize classification through the old getter events should move to the new predicate events
Adds regression tests in SCM Item Journal
quote: Avoid classifying ordinary item journal lines and templates as manufacturing records when optional Manufacturing enum-getter subscribers are absent.
